expectations.text: Applies the reasoning to Python/backend (does NOT give React- or hook-specific advice)
expectations.evidence: Entirely FastAPI/SQLAlchemy/Pydantic framed: 'orders/ routes.py discounts.py', 'no FastAPI, no SQLAlchemy session'. No React or hook advice.

expectations.text: Recommends a real abstraction (pure function / service / repository) over reflexive file-splitting
expectations.evidence: 'calculate_discount(subtotal, customer_tier, coupon) -> Decimal ... a real abstraction — a named interface that hides its internals — not just relocated code.'

expectations.text: Co-locates tightly coupled handler+logic; separates only cleanly-standalone layers (e.g. discount calc or DB access)
expectations.evidence: 'Keep handlers + schemas + queries together in one module — they're coupled'; extracts only the pure discount logic that passes the isolation test.

expectations.text: Applies the understood-in-isolation test and/or the ~300-line guidance to the module
expectations.evidence: 'can this concern be understood in isolation?' plus 'it crosses ~300–400 lines and signal-to-noise starts dropping'.
